alert_watches_threshold.name: alert_watches_threshold
alert_watches_threshold.value: ("alert_watches"."threshold_idr" IS NULL AND "alert_watches"."direction" IS NULL) OR ("alert_watches"."threshold_idr" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000000 AND "alert_watches"."direction" IS NOT NULL)

users_phone_complete.name: users_phone_complete
users_phone_complete.value: ("users"."phone_nonce" IS NULL AND "users"."phone_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "users"."phone_hmac" IS NULL) OR (octet_length("users"."phone_nonce") = 12 AND octet_length("users"."phone_ciphertext") BETWEEN 17 AND 64 AND octet_length("users"."phone_hmac") = 32)
